nesnd_huguang_preparations_reason.zh: 朱班博整顿湖广时曾修复襄阳工事，召集青年军官任教，又用军工铁件向川蜀换取粮食。伤兵与退伍军人分入后勤、屯垦卫所，留在襄阳的共和派协助总督府改造岳麓书院。二十年间，总督府掌握的军队、田赋与书院渐成一体，朝中又有陈东阳为奥援。时人多以襄阳兵为“新西府”的魁首，南明联邦也不能缺少这根柱石。\n\n然而，曾经极力支持朱班博的郑家如今屡屡指责襄阳拖欠税款、瞒报户籍。石元辅、林汉涵等亲近湖广的南兵高层相继外调，朝中与我们交好的共和派官员也受到排挤。我们必须做好最坏的准备：重新核定屯田兵农丁口，接续上游粮运，并争取书院中即将步入政坛的监生。
nesnd_huguang_preparations_reason.en: When Zhu Banbo reorganised Huguang, he repaired the fortifications of Xiangyang, brought young officers into teaching, and exchanged military ironware for grain from Sichuan. Wounded and retired soldiers entered supply services and farming garrisons. Republicans who remained in Xiangyang helped the governor-general reform Yuelu Academy. Over twenty years, the army, land revenues and academies became closely bound to his government, with Chen Dongyang supporting it at court. Xiangyang’s troops came to be regarded as the leaders of the New Western Administration, an indispensable pillar of the Southern Ming federation.\n\nThe Zheng family once supported Zhu Banbo vigorously. Now it repeatedly accuses Xiangyang of withholding taxes and concealing households. Southern officers friendly to Huguang, including Shi Yuanfu and Lin Hanhan, have been posted away, while our republican allies at court face exclusion. We must prepare for the worst: reassess the soldiers and farming households of the garrisons, restore grain shipments from upriver, and win over the academy students who will soon enter political life.
nesnd_huguang_preparations_reason.reason: 保留作者对西府政治根基和郑氏排挤的叙述；学政不作学籍/教育机关；朱斑博统一为朱班博。

nesnd_huguang_preparations_reason.current_zh: 朱班博整顿湖广时，曾修复襄阳工事，召集青年军官任教，又用军工铁件向川蜀换取粮食。伤兵与退伍军人分入后勤、屯垦卫所，留在襄阳的共和派协助总督府重建书院。\n\n二十年间，总督府的军队、田赋与学籍渐成一体。如今杭州催交兵饷，各府的调令也愈加频繁。湖广须重新核定屯田与兵员，充实书院，接续上游的粮运，以备南朝再起战事。
nesnd_huguang_preparations_reason.current_en: 朱班博整顿湖广时曾修复襄阳工事，召集青年军官任教，又用军工铁件向川蜀换取粮食。伤兵与退伍军人分入后勤、屯垦卫所，留在襄阳的共和派协助总督府改造岳麓书院。二十年间，总督府的军队、田赋、学政渐成一体。加上朝廷中有陈东阳为奥援。时人多以襄阳兵为“新西府”的魁首。更是南明联邦建国不可或缺的柱石。\n\n然而，曾经极力支持朱斑博的郑家屡屡在朝廷中指责襄阳方面拖欠税款、瞒报户籍。又外放石元辅、林汉涵等亲湖广派的南兵高层和许多亲近湖广的共和派官员。一系列迹象表明我们必须做好最坏准备。重新核定屯田兵农丁口，接续上游的粮运，在书院中造势拉拢士子。以备不时之需。

nesnd_hna_academy_button_desc.zh: 襄阳的岳麓书院是湖广官员与议政士子的精神中心。院中监生一面读书，一面习议国事，日后须通过礼议院的考试，才能进入南朝政坛。书院自创办以来便以忠于南朝训育诸生，如今南府步步相逼，我们须让教员讲明：把持朝政的郑吴与朱明皇室并非一体。今日在讲席间争取到的士子，或许就是来日同我们共进退的学政。
nesnd_hna_academy_button_desc.en: Yuelu Academy in Xiangyang is the intellectual centre of Huguang’s officials and aspiring politicians. Its students study and debate public affairs before taking the examinations of the Assembly of Rites to enter Southern political life. Loyalty to the Southern realm has guided their education since the academy’s foundation. With the Southern Administration pressing us at every turn, its teachers must distinguish the Zheng rulers who dominate the government from the Zhu imperial house. Students won over in the lecture hall today may stand with us as provincial delegates tomorrow.
nesnd_hna_academy_button_desc.reason: 按最新用户设定重写政治教育因果；不把书院降格为粮饷培训；考试只叙述制度，不冒称按钮有考试机制。

nesnd_hna_academy_button_desc.current_zh: 襄阳书院曾为湖广造就军官、教员与办事之吏。恢复各县选送生员的办法，使总督府的政令有人施行，地方的粮饷有人核算。
nesnd_hna_academy_button_desc.current_en: 襄阳的岳麓书院是湖广派官员、仪政士子的精神中心。但是它建立时起就奉行着忠于南朝的“爱国”教育。在南府频频发难的危急时刻，我们必须整顿人员，让岳麓教员们在我们的指挥下逐渐将把持朝政的倭吴丑类和朱明皇室区分开。以团结我内部思想以备不测。

If the ministers who threaten us make their move, Xiangyang must have food and weapons.

nesnd_hna_veterans_button_desc.zh: 朱班博治楚时，楚兵待遇已远优于南朝友军。他又仿照北朝规定退伍年限、组织老兵集会，使受过训练的退伍士兵带领垦丁充实乡里，改善久困于战火的湖广民生。如今各地集会已有根基，老兵既熟悉营伍，也熟悉乡里。召集他们筹办粮食、救济与后勤，战时动员便可有所依凭。
nesnd_hna_veterans_button_desc.en: Under Zhu Banbo, Chu soldiers enjoyed better conditions than their Southern allies. He also borrowed northern practices of fixed service terms and veterans’ assemblies, sending trained former soldiers to lead farming settlers and rebuild communities exhausted by war. These assemblies are now well established. Their veterans know both the army and the countryside; calling them together to organise food, relief and supplies will give wartime mobilisation a firm local foundation.

nesnd_hna_veterans_button_desc.current_en: 朱班博时代起，楚兵待遇优厚就远超南朝友军。其中更包括学自北朝的退伍年限和老兵集会。意图以此驱使受训听话的退伍士兵带领垦丁充实乡里，最终快速革新、改善久困于战火的湖广社会民生。时至今日，形成规模的“集会”老兵既熟悉营伍，也熟悉乡里。除了能在战时听令动员民众之外，我们也可以借助集会的力量对民众进行经济、生活上的动员准备。

nesnd_federal_compact_button_desc.zh: 新政已使南朝无法退回旧日的藩镇格局，杭州南府也不能再独断国政。各省学政将在礼议院议定任官、赋额、军费与省制，内阁及六部则须依新定礼法施政。我们应先遣使争取西府各省与海外诸邦的支持，使朱姓天子摆脱南府的挟持，依礼法主持国政。
nesnd_federal_compact_button_desc.en: Reform has carried the Southern realm beyond the old order of military fiefs. Hangzhou can no longer decide its government alone. Provincial delegates will debate appointments, taxation, military funding and provincial powers in the Assembly of Rites, while the cabinet and Six Ministries must govern under the revised constitution. We should first seek support from the Western provinces and overseas states, allowing the Zhu sovereign to govern constitutionally, free of the Southern Administration’s domination.

nesnd_federal_compact_button_desc.current_zh: 南京的帝统、杭州的兵财与各府的地方权力，须有共同遵守的章程。重新议定任官、赋额与军费，使朱姓天子仍能主持南朝的国政。
nesnd_federal_compact_button_desc.current_en: 在新政完全实现已不可阻挡的今天，局势已经逐渐脱离了杭州南府的掌控——这是好的！由此，我们需要重新平衡杭州的势力与西府各省。就像过去的“大礼议”改变了北明中期的国家格局，我们应当在各省代表共同支持的如今，从速召开额外的大礼议会（南明国家议会）和内阁会议。重新议定任官、赋额、军费、省制。以北朝、西夷、东洲施行的宪法/礼法制度为参照，重整政治。或可使朱姓天子终于挣脱桎梏，主持南朝国政。

nesnd_federal_compact_button_alt_desc.zh: 新政已使南朝无法退回旧日的藩镇格局，而杭州南府仍掌握着推行新政所需的兵财。易代改姓的时机已然成熟。我们应先遣使争取各省与海外诸邦，再请礼议院与内阁议定任官、赋额、军费、省制以及朱明皇室的地位。以礼法确立君权与议政之权，为郑氏称制奠定国制。
nesnd_federal_compact_button_alt_desc.en: Reform has carried the Southern realm beyond the old order of military fiefs, while Hangzhou still commands the troops and revenues needed to sustain it. The time has come for a new dynasty. We should first seek the consent of the provinces and overseas states, then bring appointments, taxation, military funding, provincial powers and the position of the Zhu house before the Assembly of Rites and cabinet. A constitution defining the powers of sovereign and assembly will lay the foundations of Zheng rule.

nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.zh: 内阁的使者来到[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]，请求我们支持保全明统的改制主张。南朝将以礼法划定中央与各省的权力，朱氏天子继续主持国政，内阁及六部依法施政，各省学政在礼议院参预国事。\n\n对本国而言，接受提议意味着承认朱明统绪，并支持这一安排。本国的政府、辖地与现行法制仍予保留；涉及海外诸邦的宗属和通商关系，另依彼此所立条约办理。
nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.en: The cabinet’s envoy has arrived in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to seek our support for a settlement preserving the Ming dynasty. A constitution will define the powers of the centre and provinces. The Zhu sovereign will remain at the head of government, the cabinet and Six Ministries will administer under law, and provincial delegates will participate through the Assembly of Rites.\n\nAcceptance commits our government to the Zhu succession and this settlement. We retain our government, territory and existing laws. The status and commerce of overseas states will continue to be governed by their separate treaties.
nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.reason: 用宪法说明中央内部制度；明确不自动吞并、不直接改变各成员法律；真实外交条约保留。
nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/replace/zzzzzzzz_nesnd_south_politics_l_simp_chinese.yml:21
nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.mechanic: event1 pending_side=1; accept sets stance1/36monthaccord/relations+15, no actual legal enactment.
nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.current_zh: 内阁将新编的盟书送到了[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。朱氏天子继续主持国政，各府保留自己的政府、领土和既有法制，以共同的朝廷协调诸邦事务。随文送来的还有一册任官与赋额的议事记录。来使要带回本国的正式答复，好让这些条款在日后的朝会上有据可循。
nesnd_south_accords.1.ming.current_en: The cabinet has delivered its proposed accord to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The Zhu emperor would continue to preside over the common court, while the provincial governments retain their territories and existing legal systems. The envoy carries records of discussions on appointments and revenues and seeks a formal reply to place before the court.

nesnd_south_accords.1.integration.zh: 南府使者提出的条件十分明确：承认郑氏易代，并将本国在中国的辖地改设为中央直接治理的行省。地方原有的独立军政权将随之收回，任官、赋额与军费纳入新朝礼法，由内阁及六部统筹。\n\n这将使南府多年推动的集权变法取得最后的成果。我们一旦答允，便是在替本地决定日后由谁施政、向谁纳税。若本国另有海外辖地，那里的政府和疆界仍予保留。
nesnd_south_accords.1.integration.en: The Southern Administration’s envoy offers clear terms: recognise Zheng accession and place our Chinese territories under direct central administration as provinces. Their separate military and political authority will end; appointments, taxation and military funding will fall under the new dynasty’s constitution and the cabinet and Six Ministries.\n\nThis would complete the centralising reforms long pursued by Hangzhou. Accepting means deciding who will govern and tax these lands. If our country also holds territory overseas, its government and boundaries there will be retained.
nesnd_south_accords.1.integration.reason: 删除簿册移交流水账；说明真实主权代价；只写接受条款，尚未即时转移领土。
nesnd_south_accords.1.integration.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/replace/zzzzzzzz_nesnd_south_politics_l_simp_chinese.yml:22

nesnd_south_accords.1.integration.current_zh: 郑氏的使者带来了改设州省的议案。参加新朝的大陆诸邦将交出中国范围内的辖地，由中央统一施政，原有田契、工坊和人口仍留在当地。地方官员须将各衙署的簿册逐项移交。使者要求在文书上写明同意的范围，署名用印以后，再由朝廷与各府共同等候改制。
nesnd_south_accords.1.integration.current_en: The Zheng envoy proposes to bring the mainland polities under direct provincial rule. Their Chinese territories covered by the agreement would pass to the central government, together with responsibility for their people, estates and workshops. The envoy has set out the lands to be transferred and now awaits our consent.

nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.zh: 南府使者要求本国承认郑氏取代朱明，并将实际持有的四国、九州辖地交由吴朝直接治理，其余领土仍由本国政府掌管。\n\n这份提议把南朝的易代与日本的疆界连在了一起。接受它可以换取新秩序中的名位，却也意味着放弃这些土地。朝廷与诸家须先认清代价，才能向杭州作答。
nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.en: The Southern Administration asks us to recognise the Zheng succession and surrender any territory we hold in Shikoku and Kyushu to direct Wu rule. Our government would retain its remaining lands.\n\nThe proposal ties a Southern dynastic succession to Japan’s borders. Acceptance would secure our place in the new order, at the cost of those territories. The court and the great houses must weigh that price before answering Hangzhou.
nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.reason: 实际日本割地条件是外交条款，仍保留；不把未来吴政权叫现成新朝。
nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/replace/zzzzzzzz_nesnd_south_politics_l_simp_chinese.yml:23
nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.mechanic: event1 pending_side2+japan; actual transfer on Wu peaceful commit, owner-controlled states only; remainingcapitalguard.
nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.current_zh: 南朝使团把新的东洋安排交到了本国政府手中。议案要求日本诸政权承认吴朝的新秩序，并将本国实际持有的四国、九州辖地交由吴朝直接治理。剩余领土仍由本国政府管理。使者正在等候答复，港口与军府也已收到核清所属辖地的命令。
nesnd_south_accords.1.japan.current_en: The southern mission has presented a new arrangement for the eastern seas. It asks the Japanese governments to recognize the Wu order and cede their own territories in Shikoku and Kyushu to direct Wu administration, retaining their other lands. The envoy awaits a reply while the ports and military offices verify the affected districts.

nesnd_south_accords.1.overseas.zh: 南府使者请[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]承认郑氏的新名位，并表示本国的政府、辖地与现有宗属安排均可延续。南朝内部如何以礼法重定君权和省权，将由其礼议院与内阁办理；我国与它的通商、港务和军费往来，仍须依各项条约行事。\n\n郑氏需要海内外的支持。我们也应在作答以前想清楚，这次易代将给本国留下怎样的位置。
nesnd_south_accords.1.overseas.en: The Southern Administration asks [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to recognise the Zheng succession while retaining our government, territory and existing status. The Assembly of Rites and cabinet will settle the Southern constitution’s distribution of sovereign and provincial powers. Our commerce, ports and military obligations will remain matters for separate treaties.\n\nThe Zheng family needs recognition at home and overseas. Before answering, we must consider the place this succession would leave for our country.

nesnd_south_accords.20.d.zh: 一年来，支持明统的各省与诸邦维持了对改制的承诺。礼议院中各省学政所议的任官、田赋与军费条陈，如今已有推行的基础。内阁请[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle][ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]颁诏，将中央与各省的权责载入国家礼法。\n\n自陈东阳重设行省布政司以来，南朝已能统一调度军政，旧封君的名位却仍牵动地方势力。过去因抗击北朝而暂且搁置的争执，终于可以在礼议院作成定议。朱明统绪得以保全，天子、内阁与各省也须各依礼法行使职权。
nesnd_south_accords.20.d.en: For a year, the provinces and states supporting Ming have upheld their commitment to reform. The provisions debated by provincial delegates in the Assembly of Rites on appointments, land taxes and military funding now have a basis for enactment. The cabinet asks [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] to proclaim a constitution defining the powers of the centre and provinces.\n\nSince Chen Dongyang restored provincial administrative commissions, the Southern government has coordinated civil and military affairs, but the titles of former feudal lords still sustain local influence. Disputes set aside during resistance to the North can at last be settled in the assembly. The Zhu succession will endure, with sovereign, cabinet and provinces each exercising authority under the constitution.
nesnd_south_accords.20.d.reason: 接收作者event10历史论说，放到真实明和平确认事件；改绝对多数、彻底结束割据/万世难改等超出机制断言。

nesnd_south_accords.20.d.current_zh: 诸府的盟书已在内阁归档。过去一年的交涉使新的赋额与议事规程逐渐站稳，地方政府也开始依照共同承认的朝廷安排行政。朱氏的帝统有了继续施政的依凭。天子将颁布重订宗盟的诏书，把这份持续履行的约定传示诸邦。
nesnd_south_accords.20.d.current_en: The provincial governments have honored their agreements for a year. Local administrations conduct their own affairs within the common court, and the Zhu emperor can proclaim a renewed compact among the southern polities.

nesnd_south_accords.21.d.zh: 支持郑氏的各方已将改制主张维持了一年。拟改设行省的各国同意交出在中国的辖地，日本诸政权也已接受有关四国、九州的条件。南府所掌兵财因此有了推行新制的依凭。\n\n礼议院与内阁将把任官、赋额、军费和省制纳入新朝礼法，重新规定君权与议政之权。郑氏若在此时受禅，就须接下这些已经许诺的责任。旧日借明廷名义施政的南府，终于要以自己的国号面对天下。
nesnd_south_accords.21.d.en: The parties supporting Zheng have sustained their commitment to reform for a year. States due for provincial integration have accepted the transfer of their Chinese territories, and the Japanese governments have accepted the terms concerning Shikoku and Kyushu. Hangzhou’s military and fiscal power now has a basis for establishing the new order.\n\nThe Assembly of Rites and cabinet will incorporate appointments, taxation, military funding and provincial government into a new constitution defining the powers of monarch and assembly. If the Zheng family accepts the throne, it must also accept these obligations. The Southern Administration, long governing in Ming’s name, will face the world under its own dynasty.
nesnd_south_accords.21.d.reason: 吴二元君主制；精确只断言中国范围整合同意+日本条件，不能称所有海外同意。

nesnd_south_accords.21.d.current_en: The mainland provinces have consented to reorganization, and the overseas and Japanese governments have delivered their replies. A year of cooperation has sustained the administration, armed forces and sea routes. The Zheng court is ready to proclaim its dynasty and assume control of the agreed territories.

nesnd_south_accords.22.d.zh: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle][ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]已颁诏施行新定礼法。各省学政在礼议院参预国政，内阁与六部承担中央施政之责，行省布政司依定议办理地方事务。朱明皇室从南府挟持下争得了施政的余地，也接受了礼法对君权的约束。\n\n这场改制保全了南明儒家特色的立宪民主联邦。各省及海外诸邦仍有自己的政府与辖地，而中央必须承担维持新制的经费。南、西两府昔日依兵力争执的权责，如今有了共同认可的裁断依据。
nesnd_south_accords.22.d.en: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has proclaimed the revised constitution. Provincial delegates participate in the Assembly of Rites; the cabinet and Six Ministries conduct central government; provincial administrative commissions administer local affairs under the settlement. The Zhu house has gained room to govern beyond Hangzhou’s domination, while accepting constitutional limits on the sovereign.\n\nThe settlement preserves Southern Ming’s Confucian form of constitutional democracy and federation. Its provinces and overseas states retain their governments and territories, and the centre assumes the expense of maintaining the new institutions. Powers once contested by the Southern and Western Administrations through military strength now have an agreed constitutional basis.

nesnd_south_accords.23.d.en: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has taken the throne and proclaimed the Wu constitution. Overseas states retaining their territories continue to govern themselves and deal with the new dynasty under their existing treaties.\n\nThe constitution recognises both the deliberative powers of the Assembly of Rites and the sovereign authority of the Zheng monarch, with the cabinet and Six Ministries conducting government accordingly. Generations of military power, commerce and overseas expansion since Zheng Zhao have at last become an empire ruled in the Zheng family’s own name.

nesnd_south_retry_confrontation_desc.current_zh: 前次交涉未成，各府仍据地拥兵。再次召集使者，要求反对诸国作出答复。
nesnd_south_retry_confrontation_desc.current_en: Our demands have yet to bring the dispute to a head. Present them again to the governments still opposing us.

nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.zh: 南朝的天下，究竟是朱氏皇帝的天下，还是郑氏开拓出来的天下？南京仍有朱明的帝统，杭州南府则掌握着推行新政的兵财。西府各省与南府共同抵御北朝时，尚能把君臣名分的争论留待来日；如今改革已深入地方，两方再不能回避谁来主持国政。\n\n湖广的书院和襄樊的营伍奉朱氏正朔，四川的共和派仍在议论南府的新政。南洋总督与日本诸侯也在衡量易代将向他们索取多少土地、钱粮和兵员。礼议院中的学政、内阁中的大臣以及各省带兵的将领，终须为自己的主张承担后果。
nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.en: Whose realm is Southern Ming: the Zhu emperor’s, or the Zheng family’s creation? Nanjing retains the imperial succession, while the Southern Administration in Hangzhou commands the troops and revenues that sustain reform. The Western provinces and Hangzhou could postpone their dispute over sovereign and minister while resisting the North. With reform reaching deep into provincial life, they can no longer avoid the question of who will govern.\n\nHuguang’s academies and Xiangfan’s troops uphold the Zhu succession, while Sichuan’s republicans continue to debate the Southern Administration’s reforms. Governors in the Southern Seas and lords in Japan weigh the land, money and soldiers a new dynasty might demand. Representatives in the Assembly of Rites, ministers in the cabinet and provincial commanders will eventually have to answer for their choices.
nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.reason: 去同一张案/账册隐喻；区分西府与南府；保留作者论争社会范围。

nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.mechanic: Board narrative; current HNA fixed Ming; generic others no unimplemented probabilities.
nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.current_zh: 南朝的天下，究竟是朱氏皇帝的天下，还是郑氏开拓出来的天下？南京的诏书遍传诸邦，杭州的商船、税吏与兵舰也遍至诸邦。三百年来奉明正朔的名义与百余年来吴国经营海陆的功业，终于被摆到了同一张案上。\n\n襄樊大营奉朱氏正朔，四川士人仍在争论南府的新政；南洋总督与日本诸侯，则盘算着改朝换代将向他们索取多少钱粮、土地和兵员。各国的札子陆续送到南京与杭州。待到奉表称臣不再足以两全，今日的主张便要由各自的军队承担。
nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.current_en: Does the southern realm belong to the Zhu emperors, or to the Zheng rulers whose fleets and armies have carried it across the seas? Edicts travel from Nanjing to the same countries reached by Hangzhou’s merchants, tax collectors and warships. Centuries of Ming legitimacy now stand against the achievements and resources of Wu.\n\nXiangfan remains loyal to the Ming. Sichuan debates the reforms of the Southern Court, while overseas governors and Japanese lords consider the money, land and troops a new dynasty might demand. Their answers will soon have to be sustained by their own forces.

nesnd_ming_court.3.d.zh: 随驾臣僚已经抵达行在，地方政府正在安置朝廷。原有军队仍须征饷调兵，布政司仍须治理各地，如今又要供给天子的行朝。拥明的主张由此有了可以奉事的中央，也使接驾之地首先承担了同南府决裂的代价。\n\n各省与海外诸邦还在遣使往来。曾经在礼议院与内阁争执的名分，如今已须由彼此的军力担保。
nesnd_ming_court.3.d.en: The accompanying ministers have reached the court’s refuge, and the local government is making room for them. Its army must still raise supplies and its administrative commissions govern the province; now it must also maintain the travelling court. Ming loyalism has acquired a centre to serve, and the host must bear the first costs of breaking with Hangzhou.\n\nEnvoys continue to arrive from the provinces and overseas states. Claims once debated in the Assembly of Rites and cabinet must now be sustained by military strength.
nesnd_ming_court.3.d.reason: 删除印信厅堂清册堆砌，写行在的政治与财政代价。

nesnd_ming_court.3.d.current_zh: 朝廷的印信和文书已经抵达行在。地方衙署腾出了厅堂，军府继续征饷调兵，随驾的臣僚开始接收各地送来的表章。原定的京中公议已经变成诸府之间的外交对峙。使者仍在两方往返，军营里也开始清点兵额和粮秣。
nesnd_ming_court.3.d.current_en: The seals and archives have reached the provisional court. Provincial offices have yielded their halls, military officials continue to collect revenues and command their forces, and the accompanying ministers receive memorials from the provinces. Deliberations at the capital have become a diplomatic confrontation. Envoys still cross between the sides as their camps muster troops and provisions.

nesnd_ming_court.9.d.zh: 湖广与四川尚无能够接驾的政府，朝廷只得留在南京。拥明大臣须继续争取地方支持，也须同掌握兵财的南府商议眼前的处境。郑氏的易代主张已摆在面前，留京廷议将决定我们还能争取多少余地。
nesnd_ming_court.9.d.en: Neither Huguang nor Sichuan can presently receive the court, which must remain in Nanjing. Ming loyalists must continue seeking provincial support while negotiating with Hangzhou, which controls the troops and revenues. The Zheng claim to the throne is already before us; deliberations in the capital will determine how much room remains to act.
nesnd_ming_court.9.d.reason: 具体接驾失败原因，不用文书道具代替政治冲突。

nesnd_ming_court.9.d.current_zh: 通往各府的使者没有带回可供朝廷驻跸的答复。宫门前的车驾仍未启程，印玺、库银和内阁文书也留在南京。朝廷必须在京中重新议定与吴王共处的章程，或承认郑氏提出的新名位。
nesnd_ming_court.9.d.current_en: The provincial replies offer no suitable refuge for the court. The carriages remain at the palace gates; the seals, treasury and cabinet papers are still in Nanjing. The court must renegotiate its arrangement with Wu or recognize the new position claimed by the Zheng house.

nesnd_ming_court.10.d.current_en: The provinces have not formed an armed coalition against the new court. Their replies demand answers on revenues, military expenses, appointments and overseas trade. The Zheng house must settle these questions if the abdication is to secure its rule.

nesnd_ming_court.12.d.zh: 地方已经与中央决裂，预定接驾的政府却发生了变故。朝廷一时无法出京，拥明大臣只能继续联络湖广与四川，寻找能够保护天子、维持行朝的接应者。留在南京的每一日，都使我们更难摆脱南府的安排。

Every further day in Nanjing makes it harder to escape Hangzhou’s arrangements.

nesnd_ming_court.12.d.current_zh: 诸府已经与中央决裂，预定接驾的地方政府又发生了变故。护送队伍无法照原路启程。留在京中的官员仍能传递消息，也必须应付新朝发下的命令。
nesnd_ming_court.12.d.current_en: The provinces have broken with the centre, but the government expected to receive the court has changed. The escort cannot follow its planned route. Officials remaining in the capital can still exchange messages while confronting the orders of the new dynasty.

nesnd_south_reconciliation_reason.zh: 南朝诸省的军政关系经过陈东阳改制，已不同于北明旧日的藩镇。可是南府与西府之间的积怨，并不会随着一场礼议自行消失。各方既已支持同一路线，中央就须承担商定的行政经费，使礼法中拟定的权责能够真正施行。\n\n海外诸邦也在等待朝廷兑现承诺。逐月维持这些安排，才有机会让易代之争重新回到可以商议的地步。
nesnd_south_reconciliation_reason.en: Chen Dongyang’s reforms have carried the Southern provinces beyond the military fiefs of the old Northern Ming order. Yet a deliberation in the assembly cannot by itself dissolve the grievances between the Southern and Western Administrations. With the parties supporting the same settlement, the centre must meet the agreed administrative expenses and put its proposed distribution of powers into practice.\n\nOverseas states also await fulfilment of the court’s commitments. Sustaining these arrangements month by month may bring the succession dispute back within reach of negotiation.
nesnd_south_reconciliation_reason.reason: 去遍海帝国网络与账册化；不把中央施政写成诸府联盟的会办。

nesnd_court_followup.19.d.zh: 易代之争已延续两年，朝廷仍未能使各方接受同一主张。南朝各省与海外诸邦继续按现有权力施政，拥明与拥吴的分歧也没有汇成一场共同的战争。\n\n我们可以就此停止此次国制交涉，承认眼前的疆界、政府与条约关系。谁也未能完成自己的改制目标，但至少不必再让天下等候一份迟迟不能议定的新法。
nesnd_court_followup.19.d.en: The succession dispute has lasted two years without a settlement acceptable to all parties. The Southern provinces and overseas states continue to exercise their existing powers, while the divide between Ming and Wu has not produced a common war.\n\nWe can close these constitutional negotiations and accept the present borders, governments and treaty relations. Neither side will have fulfilled its programme of reform, but the realm need no longer wait for a constitution that remains beyond agreement.
nesnd_court_followup.19.d.reason: 僵局结算不是新宪法/盟约通过；保留实际主权状态。

nesnd_court_followup.19.d.current_zh: 围绕易代的交涉已延续两年。各府仍按自己的主张处理政务，中央送出的盟书也未能促成一次共同承认的定议。商旅继续往来，军队驻守原地，诸府的名号与辖境沿用至今。\n\n朝廷可以据此停办此次会商，将现行安排录为成约。此后君臣之间的往来，仍由各自保有的条约和实际权力决定。
nesnd_court_followup.19.d.current_en: Two years of negotiations have produced no common settlement. Provincial governments continue to administer their territories, and the central accords have not secured a general agreement. The existing borders, governments and treaties remain in force.\n\nThe court may now end this round of negotiations and recognize the arrangements currently in place.

nesnd_crisis.10.d.zh: 各省学政在礼议院支持新法，任官、田赋与军费条陈由此写入南明的国家礼法。明廷保全了朱氏统绪，中央与各省的权责也有了共同认可的依据。\n\n陈东阳重设行省布政司时，南朝已能够统一调度军政，却没有一并解决旧封君的名位与地方权力。南、西两府面临北朝南下，曾以共同的军队压服不从。如今，因战事而暂且搁置的争执终于有了法定的处置办法。
nesnd_crisis.10.d.en: Provincial delegates in the Assembly of Rites have supported the new provisions on appointments, land taxation and military funding, incorporating them into Southern Ming’s constitution. The Zhu succession endures, and the powers of the centre and provinces now rest on an accepted legal foundation.\n\nChen Dongyang’s restoration of provincial administrative commissions enabled common civil and military administration without fully resolving the status of former feudal lords and their local powers. Facing the northern advance, the Southern and Western Administrations had joined their armies to suppress resistance. Disputes then postponed by war have at last received a constitutional settlement.
nesnd_crisis.10.d.reason: 作者稿精修；绝对多数/永久消灭所有地方权力无机制依据，改为支持新法和权力边界。

nesnd_crisis.10.d.current_zh: 南京终于收到各府签押的新约。任官、田赋与军费的争议，被列入朝廷与各府共同遵守的章程。朱姓王室保有帝统，南府仍经营其广阔的海陆产业，地方总督也得以凭明文约定参与国政。\n\n这些约定经历了反复交涉。每一笔赋额、每一个官缺，都牵动着一支军队或一群士人的生计。如今，[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]得以沿用旧有的名号，开始组织一套新的政治生活。
nesnd_crisis.10.d.current_en: 随着各省学政（南明国会议员）在大礼议上以绝对多数表明了对新法的支持。以中央政府为核心的任官、田赋与军费改革终于统合为广泛承认的系列条陈，写入南明的国家“礼法”。依照新法，明廷，或者说现政权的明廷，终于结束了自西历15世纪初塞王之乱以来的地方割据的状态。\n\n当然，在行政上的统一于陈东阳重设行省布政司时就完成了。但那时的政策并未命令废止“封君”制度，也没有确定中央政府和地方的权力边界。只是南、西两府面临北朝南下的危机空前团结，以至于无人对南京（实际是杭州）统一执行军政事权、任免官员、捕杀不从的力量发出异议。即使有，也早在两府大兵的铁蹄铁铳下碾为尘埃——如今，这一切的努力终于刻入石头，万世难改。

nesnd_crisis.11.d.zh: 首辅护卫查获了一封伪造的换防手令。携信者与同伙很快被锦衣卫、大理寺捕获，分别收押；陈东阳先被送往安全之地，待案犯落网才返回住处。\n\n调查随后牵出经办军需、海运的官员，以及同他们往来的各省名绅与旧封君。大理寺主张公开案情，借此追究藏在官场中的关系；锦衣卫则坚持封锁消息，以免惊动尚未落网的人。内阁须决定如何继续查办，也须承担事情扩大后的政治后果。
nesnd_crisis.11.d.en: The chief minister’s guards have intercepted a forged order changing the watch. The Embroidered Uniform Guard and Court of Judicial Review arrested its bearer and accomplices. Chen Dongyang was taken to safety and returned only after the suspects had been secured.\n\nThe investigation then implicated officials handling military procurement and shipping, together with their contacts among provincial gentry and former feudal lords. The Court of Judicial Review favours disclosure to expose their official connections; the Embroidered Uniform Guard insists on secrecy to avoid alerting suspects still at large. The cabinet must decide how to proceed and bear the political consequences.

nesnd_crisis.11.d.current_zh: 首辅护卫在核验随行人员时，查获了一封私换护卫的密信。接应地点随即被封锁，涉案者分别收押，陈东阳得以返回住处。\n\n清查很快触及承办军需与海运的人家。他们同南府和各地营伍往来密切，掌握着朝廷正在查核的旧账。公开案情，可以使内阁继续追究这些关系；秘密审办，则须依靠护卫与亲信维持首辅的安全。
nesnd_crisis.11.d.current_en: 首辅护卫在核验随行人员时，查获了一封伪造的换防手令。携带密信的人员及其同伙很快被锦衣卫和大理寺抓捕，按照身份和参与事情分别收押。首辅本人被当即送往安全地点，在案犯落网后才得以返回住处。\n\n对案犯的调查一发不可收拾。触及承办军需、海运的一些关键岗位的官员。而这些嫌疑人又同各省名绅大户乃至圈禁的旧藩邦君往来密切。这些人似乎掌握着刑部、大理寺在首辅要求下秘密核查的一些走私案的关键信息。然而，大理寺和锦衣卫对于下一步的行动产生了分歧。由大理寺审办，对刑事官员们公开案情，被内阁认为是可以从明面上开始大规模的内部调查，方便行事。锦衣卫方面则坚持应该封锁消息、秘密调查，不能打草惊蛇，以麻痹逆贼、防止事态扩大。

nesnd_crisis.20.d.zh: 倭吴叛明称制的消息传来，江北大臣纷纷弹冠相庆。更有人提起牧家天子当年御辇南下的盛举。伪吴与西府诸省决裂互斗，若无暇北顾，南征统一或可一举成功。\n\n边将已经请求拨饷，并派人联络湖广的“有识之士”。然而，我朝也远非太平兴国之世。国内政务仍须军队与财力维持，地权改革若尚未完成，更难兼顾南征。此时卷入南朝的混战，究竟能为帝国赢得什么？
nesnd_crisis.20.d.en: News that the despised Wu have cast off Ming and claimed the throne has brought celebration among ministers north of the river. Some recall the Mu sovereign’s great southern expedition. If the pretenders are consumed by fighting the Western provinces, a new campaign might reunify the realm in a single stroke.\n\nFrontier commanders have requested funds and contacted “men of understanding” in Huguang. Yet our own realm is far from settled. Domestic government still requires troops and money; unfinished land reform would make a southern expedition more burdensome still. What could the empire gain by entering this struggle now?
nesnd_crisis.20.d.reason: 保留北朝敌视吴的阵营语气；原稿无条件说土改继续，事件实际可在土改后触发，改条件性。

nesnd_crisis.20.d.current_zh: 南朝易代的消息传来，北方军中又有人提起牧仲棠当年的南征。如今郑氏与各府决裂，长江以南的驻军和粮运都将卷入争夺，统一的主张重新进入朝廷的议论。\n\n边将请拨军饷，派员联络湖广。国内正在推进的地权改革同样需要官员、经费与可靠的驻军。[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]必须决定，将这些力量用于国内的治理，还是重新投入南方战争。
nesnd_crisis.20.d.current_en: 倭吴叛明称制的消息传来，江北大臣纷纷弹冠相庆。更有人提起牧家天子当年御辇南下的盛举。毕竟伪吴郑狗与西府各省决裂互斗中无暇北顾。南征统一或可一举成功。\n\n有心人的策动下，边将请拨军饷，并派员联络湖广的“有识之士”。然而，我朝却不是什么太平兴国之世界。国内正在推进的地权改革仍在继续。如果在改革期间卷入南朝的混战，未来是福是祸仍未可知也。

nesnd_crisis.40.d.zh: 战事平定以后，地方军政陆续归入吴朝统辖。新朝须面对的已是怎样施政：被战争打断的生产与通商要恢复，各省百姓仍须生活，曾经反对郑氏的官员与士人也不会随战败一同消失。\n\n南府多年积累的军财足以支持重建。我们可以分案审理抵抗者，留用熟悉地方的人才；也可以借胜利清查旧党，使军队成为新秩序的支柱。无论如何处置，天下将从这些政令中认识郑氏自己的朝廷。
nesnd_crisis.40.d.en: With the fighting ended, local civil and military authority is passing under Wu rule. The new dynasty must now govern: production and trade disrupted by war must recover, people need their livelihoods, and officials and scholars who opposed Zheng will not disappear with defeat.\n\nHangzhou’s accumulated military and fiscal strength can sustain reconstruction. We may judge opponents individually and retain experienced local officials, or use victory to purge the old parties and make the army the foundation of the new order. These decisions will show the realm what government in the Zheng family’s own name means.
nesnd_crisis.40.d.reason: 作者English稿“伪南府”与吴胜利事件本方叙述相冲突，明确删伪；非擅改敌方立场。

usm_civilwar.1.d.zh: 郑氏已提出易代，要求各省与海外诸邦奉吴正朔。南府所掌军财使这项主张有了力量，朱氏数百年的帝统却仍有追随者；礼议院与内阁中未能平息的争执，终于传到了地方。\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]须就此作答。承认吴朝，便接受郑氏以新礼法主持中央；举兵奉明，则须联络同道，准备抵抗南府军队。也有人主张趁此脱离原有隶属，由本国自行主持政务。
usm_civilwar.1.d.en: The Zheng family has demanded a new dynasty and recognition from the provinces and overseas states. Hangzhou’s military and fiscal power gives force to its claim, but the centuries-old Zhu succession still commands loyalty. The dispute unresolved in the Assembly of Rites and cabinet has now reached the provinces.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must answer. Recognition accepts Zheng government under the new constitution; taking up arms for Ming requires allies and preparations against Hangzhou’s forces. Others would use the crisis to leave the existing hierarchy and govern independently.
usm_civilwar.1.d.reason: 避免尚未正式执行accession就称已有天子诏；国际国家与国内省分开。

usm_civilwar.1.d.current_zh: 南京颁下禅位诏书，命各府奉郑氏正朔。南府所辖的中央军、财赋机关与海外商馆已开始改用新朝名号，地方总督也须上表，承认郑氏统辖海内外的权力。\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的军队、官员与地方议局，长期依照同明朝订立的旧约行事。承认易代，便须同吴朝重新确定这些权利；举兵奉明，则须联络各府，准备迎击南府的中央军。亦有人主张退出旧有的隶属，自行主持地方国政。
usm_civilwar.1.d.current_en: 南京颁下禅位诏书，命各府奉郑氏正朔。南府所辖的中央军、财赋机关与海外商馆已开始改用新朝名号，地方总督也须上表，承认郑氏统辖海内外的权力。\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的军队、官员与地方议局，长期依照同明朝订立的旧约行事。承认易代，便须同吴朝重新确定这些权利；举兵奉明，则须联络各府，准备迎击南府的中央军。亦有人主张退出旧有的隶属，自行主持地方国政。

usm_civilwar.2.d.zh: 反对易代的檄文已经传开。吴朝调集中央军，要求地方承认郑氏统治；奉明各省则联络营伍，筹措共同作战的兵力与粮饷。曾共同抵御北朝的南府与西府，如今终于兵戎相见。\n\n江海商路将承载军队，也会因战争而受阻。海外属邦、邻国与远方的商人都须重新决定自己的去向。无论哪一方获胜，战后的政府都要面对参战者为其流血所提出的要求。
usm_civilwar.2.d.en: Proclamations against the succession have spread. Wu is assembling the central army to enforce recognition of Zheng rule; Ming loyalist provinces are gathering troops and supplies for common resistance. The Southern and Western Administrations, once united against the North, now face one another in arms.\n\nMaritime and river trade routes will carry armies and suffer the disruption of war. Overseas dependencies, neighbouring states and distant merchants must choose their course anew. Whoever wins will inherit the demands of those who shed blood for victory.

usm_civilwar.3.d.zh: 地方的反对尚未汇成共同举兵的联盟。仍然归顺的各省与海外诸邦承认郑氏的新名位，另有一些地方退出了原有隶属。南府得以继续主持中央，却不能因此把所有人的沉默都当作拥戴。\n\n新朝须按礼法任官施政，也须凭现有军财维护自己的统治。那些尚未解决的地方关系，将由往后的建设、交涉与争端逐渐决定。
usm_civilwar.3.d.en: Local opposition has failed to form a coalition for common war. Provinces and overseas states that remain loyal recognise Zheng rule, while others have left the previous hierarchy. Hangzhou can continue governing the centre, but cannot treat every silence as consent.\n\nThe new dynasty must appoint officials and govern under its constitution, while sustaining authority with the troops and revenues it possesses. Unresolved relations with the provinces and states will be shaped by future development, negotiation and conflict.
usm_civilwar.3.d.reason: 准确无共同反吴联盟不等于全体同意整合。

usm_civilwar.3.d.current_zh: 各府的表章陆续抵达杭州，承认郑氏的新朝。退出旧有隶属的地方也未能组成共同举兵的联盟，中央军与海陆财赋机关因此得以继续运转。\n\n南府经营多年的权力已有了帝国的名分。接下来，各省官员将按新朝的章程任用，军饷和税赋亦须重新核定。海内外的臣民将从这些政令中认识[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。
usm_civilwar.3.d.current_en: 各府的表章陆续抵达杭州，承认郑氏的新朝。退出旧有隶属的地方也未能组成共同举兵的联盟，中央军与海陆财赋机关因此得以继续运转。\n\n南府经营多年的权力已有了帝国的名分。接下来，各省官员将按新朝的章程任用，军饷和税赋亦须重新核定。海内外的臣民将从这些政令中认识[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。

usm_civilwar.10.d.zh: 联军已经击败吴朝的中央军。奉明的旗号曾使西府诸省与各方同道一同作战，如今胜利者却须回答另一件事：南京的中央政府将由谁主持？\n\n朱氏宗室仍有重返帝位的主张，获胜的地方领袖也不愿轻易交出军政大权。共和派则希望把并肩作战的国人带入新的议政制度。战时共同反吴的联盟能否容纳这些主张，将决定南朝此后的国制。
usm_civilwar.10.d.en: The coalition has defeated Wu’s central army. The Ming cause brought the Western provinces and their allies together; victory now raises another question: who will govern from Nanjing?\n\nThe Zhu house still claims the throne, while victorious provincial leaders are reluctant to surrender their military and political authority. Republicans want the citizens who fought together to share in a new deliberative government. Whether the wartime coalition can accommodate these demands will determine the Southern realm’s future constitution.
usm_civilwar.10.d.reason: 此处真正军事联盟保留联盟；不给各地议局赋予中央国会职权。

nesnd_protect_chen_button_desc.zh: 陈东阳主持的改制触及士族、旧封君与军官的田产和爵位。东关先生本人虽无所畏惧，朝廷却不能轻视这些敌意。安排专任护卫，并决定是否令他暂留官署、清查内应，以保全继续推动新政的力量。\n\n警卫任期#v 六个月#!。未设专卫时，本案死亡、负伤、脱险的概率为#v 40／25／35#!；详细经费与续办办法见警卫议案。
nesnd_protect_chen_button_desc.en: Chen Dongyang’s reforms threaten the estates and titles of gentry, former feudal lords and military officers. Master Dongguan may be fearless, but the court cannot disregard their hostility. Assign dedicated guards and consider keeping him at his residence or investigating insiders, preserving the leader needed to sustain reform.\n\nProtection lasts #v six months#!. Without dedicated guards, the case has death, injury and escape chances of #v 40/25/35#!. Funding and renewal terms appear in the protection proposal.
nesnd_protect_chen_button_desc.reason: 把用户保护改革领袖的动机接到真正后覆盖警卫按钮；保留真实有期限/风险，不恢复旧永久保护。

nesnd_protect_chen_button_desc.current_zh: 安排六个月警卫，清查随行人员与船务文书。经费、续办日期及遇刺风险见案卷。\n\n未安排警卫时，本案死亡、负伤、脱险概率为#v 40／25／35#!。本案至多发生一次。警卫到期后，遇刺风险恢复。
nesnd_protect_chen_button_desc.current_en: Provide a six-month guard for the Chief Minister and investigate those responsible for his travels.\n\nWithout protection, the chances of death, injury and escape are #v 40/25/35#!. The attempt can occur only once. Protection must still be in force when it occurs.

nesnd_chen.1.d.zh:
陈东阳从西秦流亡南明，与吴王郑钦合力推动改制，国人共和派也由此进入南朝政权的中心。如今新政触及士族、旧封君和军官的田产与爵位，反诗、威胁信接连传来。东关先生仍以国事为念，内阁却不能把他的安危全托付给旧日同盟。

朝廷可以给饷选派亲卫，也可以令首辅暂留官署，另行清查随从与接应人员。保护改革的领袖需要经费，也会使掌管警卫的内阁取得更多权力。

$nesnd_chen.finance_rules$
nesnd_chen.1.d.en:
Chen Dongyang came to Southern Ming as an exile from Western Qin and joined King Zheng Qin of Wu in reforming the state. Guoren republicans thereby entered the heart of Southern government. Reform now threatens the estates and titles of gentry, former feudal lords and officers; hostile verses and threatening letters continue to arrive. Master Dongguan remains absorbed in public affairs, but the cabinet cannot entrust his safety entirely to old alliances.

The court may fund a personal guard, keep him at his residence, or investigate his attendants and contacts. Protecting the leader of reform will cost money and place more power in the hands of the cabinet directing his guards.

$nesnd_chen.finance_rules$
nesnd_chen.1.d.reason: 采用作者攻击改革领袖背景；删账册隐喻；保留具体代价与术语。

nesnd_chen.1.d.current_zh:
陈东阳自西秦流亡南明，与吴王郑钦合力推行改制，国人共和派由此进入了南朝权力的中心。改制所倚仗的军队、财赋机关和海外商馆，至今多由南府掌握；内阁拟议的人事与田产新章，也须经这些机构传行。

如今陈东阳每次出行，船只、侍从与沿途接应的人手都要另行核定。内阁请求由[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]拨给专款，调集听命于首辅的亲卫，承担随行和居所的警戒。朝廷应当为这位改革领袖付出多少，又肯交给他多少调度人手的权力，已经列入今日的议程。

$nesnd_chen.finance_rules$
nesnd_chen.1.d.current_en:
Chen Dongyang entered Southern Ming as an exile from the Western Qin revolution. His alliance with Prince Zheng Qin brought the national republicans into the centre of southern government. Much of the army, revenue administration and overseas trading network remained under the Southern Command; the Cabinet depended on those institutions to carry out its appointments and land measures.

Every journey now requires another arrangement of ships, attendants and local escorts. The Cabinet asks [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to fund a guard answerable to the Chief Minister. Its pay and authority are before the court today.

$nesnd_chen.finance_rules$

nesnd_supply_preparations_reason.zh: 吴人的海船把南洋稻米、远方木材与各国货物运进南朝，内陆工坊、营伍与书院也早已依赖这些往来。各省虽保有不同的地方势力，生产和生计却已难以独立于共同市场。停下一处港口、截断一条商路，损失便会传到远方。\n\n明廷与南府争论帝统时，[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]仍须维持自己的军政。官署要用纸，营伍要补兵添械，书院中的监生也正从讲席走向议政。我们既要同愿意往来的诸邦维持交易，又要使本地工坊、学校与乡里的生计经得住眼前的动荡。
nesnd_supply_preparations_reason.en: Wu shipping brings grain from the Southern Seas, distant timber and foreign goods into the Southern realm. Inland workshops, garrisons and academies already depend on those exchanges. Provincial powers differ, but production and livelihoods can scarcely stand apart from the common market. Closing a port or severing a trade route spreads losses far beyond it.\n\nAs the Ming court and Hangzhou dispute the succession, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must keep its government and forces functioning. Offices need paper, garrisons need recruits and arms, and academy students are preparing to enter political life. We must maintain trade with willing partners and make local workshops, schools and livelihoods capable of enduring the present disruption.
nesnd_supply_preparations_reason.reason: 学校不是培养粮饷小吏；保留此JE确实建筑/商品/就业条件，不给没有HNA限定的日志硬塞襄阳唯一背景。

nesnd_supply_preparations_reason.current_zh: 吴人的海船把南洋的稻米、远方的木材和各国的货物运进南朝，内陆的工坊、营伍与学堂也早已依赖这些往来。旧日各府可以据地自守，今日停下一处港口、扣住一批货物，损失便会沿着商路传到许多人的家中。\n\n南京与杭州争论帝统的时候，商人同样在衡量自己的前程。[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的官署需要纸张，军队需要粮饷与军械，工坊中的人需要靠工钱生活。我们当与愿意往来的诸邦重续交游，也须让本国的生产支撑起这些生计。商路能否经受朝争，将决定我们届时有多少余力。
nesnd_supply_preparations_reason.current_en: Wu’s ships carry grain and raw materials between distant ports. The workshops, garrisons and schools of the southern countries have come to depend on that traffic. A closed harbour or a detained cargo can now take livelihoods away far beyond its own shores.\n\nWhile Nanjing and Hangzhou dispute the dynasty, merchants consider their own future. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] needs paper for its offices, supplies for its soldiers and employment for its people. We must renew our trading connections and sustain the production at home that gives us room to act.

nesnd_external_hus_desc.zh: 南朝易代的消息传到了东洲。曾与我们争夺独立的郑氏海上帝国，如今又因谁应当主持天下而分裂。反对郑氏的势力可能向共和国寻求援助，商人则在关注港口与航路的去向。\n\n我们可以借此扩大对外交往，援助别国却须动用自己的国库与工厂。政府应当判断哪些关系有利于共和国，又能承担多少承诺。
nesnd_external_hus_desc.en: News of the Southern succession has reached Dongzhou. The Zheng maritime empire that we fought for independence is again divided over who should rule it. Its opponents may seek support from our republic, while merchants watch for changes to the ports and routes on which they depend.\n\nWe can pursue those openings, but assistance abroad will draw on our own treasury and industry. The government must decide which relationships serve the republic and which commitments it can sustain.
nesnd_external_hus_desc.reason: 去国库/工厂各交账目的机械隐喻；具体独立战争记忆与现实财力约束。
nesnd_external_hus_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:7
nesnd_external_hus_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_hus_desc.current_zh: 南明易帜的消息传到了东洲。商馆将南洋的船期和各藩的动静抄在同一份报告上；当年独立战争留下的名字，又一次出现在议员们的案头。若南方诸国各自立政，郑氏的海上帝国便要分出新的关口与航路。共和国的国库、工厂和船队，也须各自交出一份账目。
nesnd_external_hus_desc.current_en: 南明易帜的消息传到了东洲。商馆将南洋的船期和各藩的动静抄在同一份报告上；当年独立战争留下的名字，又一次出现在议员们的案头。若南方诸国各自立政，郑氏的海上帝国便要分出新的关口与航路。共和国的国库、工厂和船队，也须各自交出一份账目。

nesnd_external_fra_desc.zh: 南朝使者请求承认易代并延续旧约，印度方面则仍有南部海岸与殖民地的争执。法国商人、债权人与军官在两地都有利益。政府须决定与谁往来，又愿意为外交主张付出多少资金与军械。
nesnd_external_fra_desc.en: Southern envoys seek recognition and the continuation of old agreements, while India remains divided by disputes over the southern coast. French merchants, creditors and officers have interests in both regions. The government must decide whom to support and how far its money and arms should follow its diplomacy.
nesnd_external_fra_desc.reason: FRA可改共和政体，删固定“皇帝裁定”；事件无当前君主守卫，不添加不安全ruler引用。
nesnd_external_fra_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:9
nesnd_external_fra_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_fra_desc.current_zh: 外交部收到了来自南明与印度的两封公文。南明的新朝要求履行旧约，莫卧儿宫廷仍在抱怨南印度的殖民地。法国的商人、债权人与军官遍布两地；他们请皇帝裁定，下一封国书应当送往何处。
nesnd_external_fra_desc.current_en: 外交部收到了来自南明与印度的两封公文。南明的新朝要求履行旧约，莫卧儿宫廷仍在抱怨南印度的殖民地。法国的商人、债权人与军官遍布两地；他们请皇帝裁定，下一封国书应当送往何处。

nesnd_external_qe1_desc.zh: 四川商队带来了南朝的消息。敦煌败绩以后，西秦更须慎用兵力与财赋。东方若再起兵戈，往来巴蜀的道路将同时牵动商贸与边防。我们应当决定，是联络川中、支持反吴联盟，还是先将财力用于本国。
nesnd_external_qe1_desc.en: Caravans from Sichuan have brought news of the Southern dispute. Since the defeat at Dunhuang, Western Qin has had to consider its military strength and finances carefully. Renewed war in the east would make the roads through Bashu more important to trade and security alike. We should decide whether to cultivate Sichuan, support the anti-Wu coalition, or keep our resources at home.
nesnd_external_qe1_desc.reason: 西秦外交当前可选SIH/反吴，写具体对象与代价；不捏造新国书动作。
nesnd_external_qe1_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:11
nesnd_external_qe1_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_qe1_desc.current_zh: 商队从四川带来了南朝的消息。敦煌败绩之后，西秦诸臣清点过边军，也清点过国库；东方若再起兵戈，往来巴蜀的道路便更关乎生计。驿骑已经备马，朝廷还须定下国书的措辞。
nesnd_external_qe1_desc.current_en: 商队从四川带来了南朝的消息。敦煌败绩之后，西秦诸臣清点过边军，也清点过国库；东方若再起兵戈，往来巴蜀的道路便更关乎生计。驿骑已经备马，朝廷还须定下国书的措辞。

nesnd_external_sha_desc.zh: 南朝争位的消息传到了北地共和国。流亡者从往事中认出参与争斗的名字，也有人开始联络东洲的同道。共和国或可从这些关系中求得资金与军械，但政府须先决定自己需要什么援助，又愿意维持怎样的往来。
nesnd_external_sha_desc.en: News of the Southern succession has reached the northern republic. Exiles recognise familiar names among those now disputing power, and some are already seeking contacts in Dongzhou. A friendly republic might supply funds or arms, but our government must decide what help it needs and what relationship it can sustain.
nesnd_external_sha_desc.reason: SHA当前请求HUS援助，不写无功能的运粮过冬与议事厅对举。
nesnd_external_sha_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:13
nesnd_external_sha_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_sha_desc.current_zh: 南方政变的传闻越过海峡，送到了北地共和国。侨居此处的旧党人从报纸上辨认着熟悉的姓氏，有人忆及长安，有人写信到东洲。码头上的船还要运粮过冬，议事厅也不能只谈远方的战事。
nesnd_external_sha_desc.current_en: 南方政变的传闻越过海峡，送到了北地共和国。侨居此处的旧党人从报纸上辨认着熟悉的姓氏，有人忆及长安，有人写信到东洲。码头上的船还要运粮过冬，议事厅也不能只谈远方的战事。

nesnd_external_bur_desc.zh: 南朝易代将改变王庭与这个强邻的往来。沿江贸易与既有条约所定的义务都不能置之不理。在向任何一方许诺资金或军械以前，朝廷须先考虑本国的地位，以及谁能维护我们的利益。
nesnd_external_bur_desc.en: The Southern succession may alter the court’s dealings with a powerful neighbour. Trade along the rivers and the obligations inherited from existing treaties remain immediate concerns. Before committing money or arms to either side, we must consider our own status and which government can best protect our interests.
nesnd_external_bur_desc.reason: 国家不是亲自颁诏者，改为明确外部局势。
nesnd_external_bur_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:15
nesnd_external_bur_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_bur_desc.current_zh: 南朝更易帝号的诏书送抵王庭。沿江商路仍在运货，地方官还在催征税款，驻外使臣已等着新的训令。朝廷须先查明本国与南明的盟约和宗藩名分，再决定这场变局中的去向。
nesnd_external_bur_desc.current_en: 南朝更易帝号的诏书送抵王庭。沿江商路仍在运货，地方官还在催征税款，驻外使臣已等着新的训令。朝廷须先查明本国与南明的盟约和宗藩名分，再决定这场变局中的去向。

nesnd_external_mug_desc.zh: 南朝易代使印度海岸的旧争端再受关注。明人在迈索尔的属地与沿海通商安排，长期牵动帝国的利益。朝臣可以向法国请求资金或军械；若南朝仍占据迈索尔土地，我们也可借此重新提出领土主张。
nesnd_external_mug_desc.en: The Southern succession offers another opening to raise our claims on the Indian coast. Ming possessions in Mysore and the arrangements of coastal traders remain sources of contention. Our ministers may seek French assistance in money or arms; if Southern rule still holds land in Mysore, we can also press our territorial claim.
nesnd_external_mug_desc.reason: 事件无保证USM此刻仍有Mysore，使用条件句；法国援助不是无条件军事干预。
nesnd_external_mug_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:17
nesnd_external_mug_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_mug_desc.current_zh: 南明的新帝登基了。宫中的地图仍将南方海岸涂作不同颜色，迈索尔的殖民地、沿海商馆与内陆诸邦各有旧约。军官请求整顿军费，朝臣请再派一位使者赴法；旧帝国必须用现有的财力，为这些要求排出先后。
nesnd_external_mug_desc.current_en: 南明的新帝登基了。宫中的地图仍将南方海岸涂作不同颜色，迈索尔的殖民地、沿海商馆与内陆诸邦各有旧约。军官请求整顿军费，朝臣请再派一位使者赴法；旧帝国必须用现有的财力，为这些要求排出先后。

nesnd_external_gbr_desc.zh: 法兰西与明人的旧同盟曾使英国航路备受挤压。如今南朝争位，商人希望借局势变化进入新的港口，政府也可重新选择交往的对象。若要用资金与军械争取影响，我们仍须衡量这项支出对本国的用处。
nesnd_external_gbr_desc.en: The old alliance between France and Ming placed heavy pressure on British trade routes. A disputed succession in the Southern realm may create openings for commerce and diplomacy. Merchants seek access to its ports, while the government weighs the expense of supporting a foreign partner.
nesnd_external_gbr_desc.reason: 删除商报账目装饰，以旧同盟→新贸易机会→援助代价为因果。
nesnd_external_gbr_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:19
nesnd_external_gbr_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_gbr_desc.current_zh: 来自东方的商报在伦敦传阅。法兰西与明人的旧同盟曾使英国航路备受挤压，如今南朝的朝号变了，船货和旧债却仍要结算。内阁请商会列出可行的生意，也请海军先报本国海面的用度。
nesnd_external_gbr_desc.current_en: 来自东方的商报在伦敦传阅。法兰西与明人的旧同盟曾使英国航路备受挤压，如今南朝的朝号变了，船货和旧债却仍要结算。内阁请商会列出可行的生意，也请海军先报本国海面的用度。

nesnd_external_rus_desc.zh: 漫长的东方疆界使南朝之争也牵动俄国的利益。一个可靠的贸易伙伴，或愿意接受援助的政府，都可能改善我们在东方的处境。朝廷可以等待胜负分明，也可以趁各方仍在寻求外援时，以资金和军械争取交往。
nesnd_external_rus_desc.en: Russia’s long eastern frontier gives the Southern dispute consequences far beyond its place of origin. A reliable trading partner or a government willing to accept our support might strengthen our position. We may wait for the outcome, or commit funds and arms while the rivals still need foreign friends.
nesnd_external_rus_desc.reason: 删除笼统账册堆案和无对象总结，说明可做的外交行动。
nesnd_external_rus_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:21
nesnd_external_rus_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_rus_desc.current_zh: 使者将南朝更立的消息送到了宫廷。东方疆界漫长，边吏的报告与商路的账册一道堆在案上。朝廷可以等待局势明朗，也可以寻求一位可靠的交易者；无论如何，调兵和拨款都须另有着落。
nesnd_external_rus_desc.current_en: 使者将南朝更立的消息送到了宫廷。东方疆界漫长，边吏的报告与商路的账册一道堆在案上。朝廷可以等待局势明朗，也可以寻求一位可靠的交易者；无论如何，调兵和拨款都须另有着落。

nesnd_external_policy.reason: 日志标题不再以账册代替外交内容。
nesnd_external_policy.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:22
nesnd_external_policy.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。

nesnd_external_policy_reason.zh: 南朝易代牵动旧约、商路与海外属邦的去向。政府须决定同谁往来，是否提供援助，又是否需要向外国求助。各项新提议尚待商定，既有条约则仍约束着签署它们的国家。
nesnd_external_policy_reason.en: The Southern succession has placed old treaties, trade routes and overseas dependencies in question. Our government must choose which relationships to cultivate and whether to offer assistance or seek it from abroad. Existing agreements continue to bind their parties while new proposals are negotiated.
nesnd_external_policy_reason.reason: 去一场政变分前程的无内容概括；保留真实外交条约。
nesnd_external_policy_reason.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:23
nesnd_external_policy_reason.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_policy_reason.current_zh: 南明的新朝已向诸国递交国书。旧约、商路和地方诸侯的去向，正从同一场政变中分出不同的前程。外交部须逐一核对来信，再决定与谁往来。
nesnd_external_policy_reason.current_en: 南明的新朝已向诸国递交国书。旧约、商路和地方诸侯的去向，正从同一场政变中分出不同的前程。外交部须逐一核对来信，再决定与谁往来。

nesnd_external_choose_desc.zh: 选择接洽国。既有条约仍然有效；本次南朝危机中只能议定一份援助。
nesnd_external_choose_desc.en: Choose a diplomatic partner. Existing treaties remain in force. Only one aid agreement can be concluded through this crisis.
nesnd_external_choose_desc.reason: 删除“本项目”开发口吻，保留一次援助限制。
nesnd_external_choose_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:26
nesnd_external_choose_desc.mechanic: 现有调用、条件和效果不变。
nesnd_external_choose_desc.current_zh: 选定接洽国。改变对象不会取消已经生效的条约；同一场危机只可经本项目落实一份援助。
nesnd_external_choose_desc.current_en: 选定接洽国。改变对象不会取消已经生效的条约；同一场危机只可经本项目落实一份援助。

nesnd_external_choose_opposition_desc.zh: 反吴联盟须已有领袖；本国须独立，且未与其交战。选定接洽对象后，再另议资金或军械。
nesnd_external_choose_opposition_desc.en: An anti-Wu coalition leader must exist. Our country must be independent and at peace with that government. Funds or arms require a separate proposal.
nesnd_external_choose_opposition_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:28

nesnd_external_choose_opposition_desc.current_zh: 须已有真实反吴领袖，本国独立且未与其交战。选定对象后仍须另议资金或军械。
nesnd_external_choose_opposition_desc.current_en: 须已有真实反吴领袖，本国独立且未与其交战。选定对象后仍须另议资金或军械。

nesnd_external_offer_money_desc.zh: 提出每周@money!#v 500#!的资金援助，约束期#v 1年#!。须有#v 26,000#!储备、固定净收入至少#v 5,000#!、总净收入至少#v 1,000#!，并满足条约签署条件。对方可以拒绝；约束期满后，仍须撤回或重谈才能停止转移。
nesnd_external_offer_money_desc.en: Offer a transfer of @money!#v 500#! per week, binding for #v 1 year#!. This requires #v 26,000#! in reserves, fixed net income of at least #v 5,000#!, total net income of at least #v 1,000#! and eligibility to sign the treaty. The other government may refuse. The transfer continues after the binding period until withdrawn or renegotiated.
nesnd_external_offer_money_desc.reason: 明确约束期不自动终止，删原生内部词；数字按现有trigger。
nesnd_external_offer_money_desc.source: author-revision-original.txt; user latest Southern canon; original ce_usm_events/flavorUSM.4.d, ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason; current localization/simp_chinese/nesnd_external_l_simp_chinese.yml:30

nesnd_external_offer_arms_desc.zh: 提出#v 10#!小武器的商品援助，约束期#v 1年#!。本国的供应、价格、出口额度与运输须满足条件。对方可以拒绝；供给或运输不足时，输送可能中止。
nesnd_external_offer_arms_desc.en: Offer a transfer of #v 10#! small arms, binding for #v 1 year#!. Our supply, prices, export allowance and transport must permit it. The other government may refuse; shortages or transport difficulties can suspend deliveries.
nesnd_external_offer_arms_desc.reason: 保留商品单位与约束期，玩家不读原生一词。

nesnd_supply.3.d.zh: 过去一季，[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的工坊与营伍有货可购，学堂、官署和厂场也逐渐补齐了人手。商人重新熟悉了往来的门路，各州的人们得以靠生产与买卖维持生活。\n\n海内外的朝争还在继续。那些装着货物驶离码头的船只，为我们留下了继续经营的本钱。
nesnd_supply.3.d.en: For the past season, workshops and garrisons in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] have been able to buy what they need, while schools, offices and factories have filled their posts. Merchants have renewed their trading contacts, and people across the states have supported themselves through production and exchange.\n\nThe Southern political dispute continues. The cargo ships leaving our ports give us the means to keep trading through it.

flavorUSM.4.d.zh:
西元1678年春，时为北明吴国公的大明南京留守使、南京礼部尚书的（吴武宗）郑昭在他在海内外的一系列军事胜利后，单方面向朝廷上书，准备进京觐见大明天子。当是时，在三十年前的大宪战争中大获全胜的天津燕主及其国势还如烈火烹油。堪称北明战国末期的天下之雄。但郑氏的执拗战胜了朝臣的规劝和敌人的威胁。终于在同年六月成行。

这次觐见是一场北明从藩镇时期到诸侯时期近三百年来都未有人见过的盛大巡游。虽然吴国主在燕、秦、齐等势力的胁迫下，最终只带了5000卫士和一些官员随行。但在这队伍中包罗了吴国海陆军事力量在那个时代的全部精锐，南洋的海兵、倭国的刀牌手、女真掷弹兵的早期营队，甚至还包括一个由“极东殷人”流亡贵族组成的，向中国皇帝伸冤借兵的队伍。并携带着吴人在这个地球上纵横百年来所获得无数珍宝，以及又用了近万名民夫运送的安南、高棉贡米。与之相对的，则是在藩镇节度使制度下被小规模械斗和转运使卡要下，四时常乱，在饥荒边缘长久徘徊的中原。

在郑昭的觐见使团归来后。他当即改其称号为”至尊“，吴国随即见证了一个南北流民向自己及殖民地不断涌入的快速发展时期。而在那之后，郑昭及其继承者也开始以更加严苛的力度推进集权主义的“专权变法”及土地商品化改革。并最终稳固了我们作为南朝尊主，总领万国的基业。吴人前进的脚步从未停下，直至今天......
flavorUSM.4.d.en:
In the spring of 1678, Zheng Zhao—later Emperor Wuzong of Wu, then Duke of Wu, Ming’s Nanjing Protector and Minister of Rites—announced that he would visit the emperor after a succession of victories at home and overseas. The ruler of Yan at Tianjin, victorious in the Great Constitutional War thirty years earlier, still stood at the height of his power. Yet Zheng’s determination overcame his ministers’ warnings and his enemies’ threats. He set out in June.

Nothing comparable to this procession had been seen in the nearly three centuries of Northern Ming’s military governors and princely states. Pressure from Yan, Qin and Qi limited Zheng to five thousand guards and a handful of officials, but the entourage included the finest of Wu’s forces: marines from the Southern Seas, Japanese swordsmen, early Jurchen grenadiers, and even exiled nobles of the Far Eastern Yin seeking imperial redress and military aid. They carried treasures gathered during a century of Wu expansion across the world, while nearly ten thousand labourers hauled tribute rice from Annam and Cambodia. Beyond the procession lay a Central Plain kept close to famine by local fighting and the exactions of military governors and transport officials.

After returning, Zheng Zhao adopted the title of Supreme Lord. Wu and its colonies entered a period of rapid growth as refugees arrived from both north and south. Zheng and his successors pressed their centralising reforms and the commercialisation of land ever harder, securing the foundations of our authority over the Southern realm and its many states. Wu’s advance has continued to this day...

flavorUSM.4.f.zh: .吾常闻朱家天子受命于天，乃神龙降世。明太祖高皇帝以一乞儿之身，执长策，灭胡氛，恢复汉家中原。功在千古，更比青史石刻永恒。所以周德虽衰，天命未改。今日一见，朱家小子亦凡人尔。\n——郑昭
flavorUSM.4.f.en: I had heard that the Zhu Son of Heaven held Heaven’s mandate, a divine dragon descended among men. The founding emperor rose from beggary, destroyed foreign rule and restored the Chinese heartland. His achievements would outlast the inscriptions of history. Though virtue might decline, the mandate seemed unchanged. Yet today I have seen him: the Zhu boy is mortal too.\n—Zheng Zhao

ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason.zh: 明朝朱姓，还是吴国郑氏？这对于中国南朝有能力参预政治的国人来说，是一个每分每秒都要自问的难题。从川边乡校的讲习台到南京礼部的议会殿。争论、札子、散文、报道，各式各样体裁的文字都在对人们呼喊。却是问多于答，争大于论。
ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason.en: Ming’s Zhu dynasty, or Wu’s Zheng house? For those able to take part in Southern Chinese politics, the question demands an answer at every moment. From village lecture halls on Sichuan’s frontier to the chamber of the Ministry of Rites in Nanjing, arguments, memorials, essays and reports call out to the public. There are more questions than answers, more quarrels than considered debate.

ce_usm_cw_japanese_interest_reason.zh: 郑氏在九州的据点，是吴国海上事业的一部分，也长期牵动日本诸家的利害。如今南朝内战，各方使者相继渡海，请日本提供兵船与军需。朝廷有机会借此次战争收回九州的吴国领地，并重新安排海峡两岸的关系。
ce_usm_cw_japanese_interest_reason.en: The Zheng foothold in Kyushu forms part of Wu’s maritime power and has long affected the interests of Japan’s great houses. With civil war threatening the Southern realm, rival envoys cross the sea seeking ships and supplies. The government has an opportunity to recover the Wu-held lands of Kyushu and reshape relations across the strait.

usm_civilwar.23.d.zh: 南朝内战使九州重新成为日本朝野关注的焦点。郑氏在当地经营的港口、商路与驻军，关系着吴朝的海上力量，也牵动着日本领主和商人的利益。\n\n吴朝与反吴诸省都在争取日本出兵，并以战后交还郑氏所持九州为条件。支援哪一方，将决定日本军队渡海后的敌友，以及战后向谁索取出兵的报偿。
usm_civilwar.23.d.en: The Southern civil war has brought Kyushu back to the centre of Japanese politics. Zheng ports, trade routes and garrisons on the island support Wu’s maritime power and affect the interests of Japanese lords and merchants.\n\nBoth Wu and its opponents seek Japanese intervention, offering to return the Zheng-held parts of Kyushu after victory. The side we support will determine our allies across the sea and the government from which we must claim our reward.

nesnd_crisis.21.d.zh: 郑氏的舰队、商馆与属地，将南朝战争的消息带到了远方。各港商人担心货物遭到扣押，交战各方的使者则要求承认自己的政府，并为军需和借款寻求援助。\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]在这些往来中有自己的利益。维持通商，需要与实际控制港口和航线的势力交涉；收容流亡者、接济反吴军队，也将使南朝的新旧政治力量同我国发生更深的联系。
nesnd_crisis.21.d.en: Zheng fleets, trading houses and dependencies have carried news of the Southern war abroad. Merchants fear the seizure of their cargoes, while envoys from the rival sides seek recognition, military supplies and loans.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has interests of its own in these exchanges. Keeping trade open requires dealings with those who control the ports and sea routes. Receiving exiles or supplying the anti-Wu forces would draw us more deeply into the Southern political struggle.

nesnd_crisis.41.d.zh: 参战军队陆续归国。地方领主要求兑现出兵时的许诺，港口商人催促恢复航运，中央也须重新安排驻军与征收。\n\n大陆战争使[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]有了整理军政的机会。统一地方征收、训练官员，可以扩大中央的施政能力；先行酬赏军功，则能稳住此次出征所倚重的将领与领主。
nesnd_crisis.41.d.en: The troops are returning from abroad. Local lords demand the rewards promised when they joined the campaign, merchants want shipping restored, and the government must arrange its garrisons and revenues.\n\nThe mainland war has given [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] an opportunity to reorganise. More consistent taxation and official training would strengthen central administration; honouring military claims first would secure the commanders and lords on whom the expedition relied.

nesnd_supply_rules.zh:
#bold 货源#!
纸张、工具、小武器无本国短缺，价格涨幅不超过#v 50%#!；东洲另需硬木。

#bold 工场与人手#!
所需建筑各有至少一座雇员达到#v 75%#!，且不缺生产投入。湖广为大学与军营；四川为工具厂，以及铁矿或伐木场；广西为纸厂与伐木场；东洲为港口与官署。招工困难时可查看[concept_pop_qualifications]、[concept_building_wage]与原料供应。

#bold 生计#!
全国无业劳动力不超过#v 12%#!；劳动力至少#v 5万#!的州不超过#v 20%#!。自给农民属于有业人口。全国无饥荒，粮食无本国短缺且涨价不超过#v 25%#!。
现有无业劳动力：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#!（#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!）；超过地方失业界线的州：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!。

#bold 商路安定#!
确定联络伙伴或依靠本国商帮，四项条件连续维持#v 12周#!。战争、破产、市场改变或任一条件不满足，连续周数重新计算。
nesnd_supply_rules.en:
#bold Supplies#!
Paper, tools and small arms must have no local shortages and cost no more than #v 50%#! above base price; Dongzhou also requires hardwood.

#bold Buildings and workers#!
Each required building type must have at least one building staffed to #v 75%#! without input shortages. Huguang requires a university and barracks; Sichuan a tooling workshop and either an iron mine or logging camp; Guangxi a paper mill and logging camp; Dongzhou a port and government administration. If recruitment is difficult, check [concept_pop_qualifications], [concept_building_wage] and input supplies.

#bold Livelihoods#!
Unemployed workers may be at most #v 12%#! of the national workforce. States with at least #v 50,000#! workers have a limit of #v 20%#!. Subsistence workers count as employed. There must be no famine or local grain shortage, and grain must cost no more than #v 25%#! above base price.
Unemployed workforce: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#! (#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!). States above the local unemployment limit: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!.

#bold Stable commerce#!
Choose a commercial partner or rely on domestic merchants, and maintain all four conditions for #v 12 weeks#!. War, bankruptcy, a change of market or failure of any condition restarts the consecutive count.

nesnd_supply_rules.current_zh:
#bold 货源#!
纸张、工具、小武器无本国短缺，价格涨幅不超过#v 50%#!；东洲另需硬木。

#bold 工场与人手#!
所需建筑各有至少一座雇员达到#v 75%#!，且不缺生产投入。湖广为大学与军营；四川为工具厂，以及铁矿或伐木场；广西为纸厂与伐木场；东洲为港口与官署。招工困难时可查看[concept_pop_qualifications]、[concept_building_wage]与原料供应。

#bold 生计#!
全国无业劳动力不超过#v 12%#!；劳动力至少#v 5万#!的州不超过#v 20%#!。自给农民属于有业人口。全国无饥荒，粮食无本国短缺且涨价不超过#v 25%#!。
现有无业劳动力：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#!（#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!）；超过地方失业界线的州：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!。

#bold 商路安定#!
确定联络伙伴或依靠本国商帮，四项条件连续维持#v 12周#!。战争、破产、市场改变或任一条件不满足，连续周数重新计算。
nesnd_supply_rules.current_en:
#bold Latest refresh#!
Unemployed workforce: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#! (#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!)
States beyond the local unemployment limit: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!

#bold Employment requirements#!
Unemployed workers may be at most #v 12%#! of the national workforce. In states with at least #v 50,000#! workers, the limit is #v 20%#!. Subsistence workers count as employed. Statistics refresh weekly and when arrangements change; completion checks current conditions.

Each required school, barracks, workshop or administrative facility must have at least one building staffed to #v 75%#! without input shortages. Check its hiring tooltip for [concept_pop_qualifications], [concept_building_wage] and [concept_good]. Education, suitable vacancies and market supplies can support occupational transitions. There must be no famine, no local grain shortage and no more than a #v 25%#! grain price increase.

Continue in the shared market, approach a foreign partner, or arrange purchases domestically. All four requirements must hold for #v 12 consecutive weeks#!; war, market changes or failed requirements restart the count.

nesnd_south_compact_detail_tt.zh:
#bold 改制承诺#!
大陆、海外与日本诸邦的承诺分别占#v 50%、30%、20%#!。承诺有效#v 36个月#!；改换立场、与中央交战、改投宗主或撤回支持后，相应承诺失效。

#bold 和平议定国制#!
所选一方的政治支持须达到#v 85#!，领先另一方#v 20#!，并连续维持#v 12个月#!。明廷须获#v 75%#!支持及至少两个大陆核心政府同意；吴方须获#v 80%#!支持、拟改省诸国与日本割地各方同意，并备有合格舰队。新制议定后，朝争结束。
nesnd_south_compact_detail_tt.en:
#bold Support for the settlement#!
Mainland, overseas and Japanese governments account for #v 50%, 30% and 20%#! respectively. Commitments last #v 36 months#! and cease to count after a change of alignment or overlord, war against the centre, or withdrawal.

#bold A peaceful constitutional settlement#!
The chosen side needs political support of #v 85#! and a lead of #v 20#!, sustained for #v 12 months#!. Ming needs #v 75%#! commitment support and at least two mainland core governments. Wu needs #v 80%#!, consent from every government due for integration and the Japanese territorial parties, and a sufficiently prepared fleet. A completed settlement ends the dispute.
nesnd_south_compact_detail_tt.reason: 指标统计支持不是宪法本身，不称国制为盟约；与中央交战才失效，保留数值。

nesnd_chen.3.d.zh: 陈东阳在前往东洲讲学的航船上遭到袭击。铳弹贯穿了他的肩臂，随从将他抬入船舱，停船延医。入夜以后，渡口传出陈公尚在人世的消息，赶来探视的门生才各自退去。\n\n这位从西秦革命走到南明改制的政治家，如今负伤卧床。他在南方的追随者将遇刺经过刊入报章，要求朝廷查明随行人手的来历；各省送往内阁的文书，也开始追问南府经办的船务和警戒。朝廷围绕新政与权力归属的争执，又添了一桩不能置之不问的血案。
nesnd_chen.3.d.en: Chen Dongyang was attacked aboard the vessel carrying him east to lecture. A shot passed through his shoulder and arm. His attendants took him below and summoned a physician. Only after nightfall did his waiting students hear that he was still alive.\n\nThe veteran of the Western Qin revolution and the southern reforms now lay wounded. His followers published accounts of the attack and demanded an inquiry into the escort. Provincial correspondence questioned the Southern Command’s shipping arrangements, adding the bloodshed to the struggle over reform and political authority.

nesnd_chen.death_residence_desc.zh: 陈东阳暂缓了远行，仍在官署批阅奏牍。厨房送来的汤药经过两道签押，守卫直到夜间才发现封口被换过。医官赶到时，陈东阳已经不能言语。\n\n天明后，内阁封存了药盏与值夜名册。南方进步派失去了主持改制的领袖，各省派驻南京的官员聚在门外，等候朝廷公布继任人选。
nesnd_chen.death_residence_desc.en: Chen postponed his journey and continued working in the guarded offices. Two signatures accompanied the medicine brought from the kitchen, but its seal had been replaced. By the time the physician arrived, Chen could no longer speak.\n\nAt dawn the Cabinet sealed the bowl and the duty register. The southern reformers had lost their leader. Provincial delegates gathered outside, waiting for the appointment of a successor.

#bold 易代压力#!：#v [Country.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_south_pressure_value')|1] / 100#!
当前每月净变化：#v [Country.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_south_monthly_pressure_value')|1]#!。通常每月#n ＋3#!，礼法定制修正生效时#n ＋2.5#!；有效和解进程另每月减少#p 3#!。

#bold 首辅案#!
自#v 1837年7月#!起，压力超过#v 24#!时可能发生；至#v 1838年初#!，尚未结案且陈东阳仍在本国，就会进入刺杀与护卫分支。死亡使压力#n ＋25#!，受伤#n ＋10#!，脱险#n ＋3#!。

案件结算后，压力达到#v 70#!可主动提前易代；达到#v 100#!且郑钦已离去，自动推进。至#v 1839年初#!仍未解决的朝争会达到#v 100#!，不再等待郑钦自然死亡，继而进入易代、诸国答复与内战交涉。已经达成的和平结局不受影响。
